purpose: Compare the repository-committed BuildOpt Wrapper with optimized native Gradle across frozen chronological public commits.

arms.control: existing Gradle Wrapper with --build-cache and frozen workflow
arms.candidate: committed ./buildoptw with the same Gradle arguments
arms.stateIsolation: separate linked worktree, HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, GRADLE_USER_HOME and BuildOpt state per arm

timing.dependencyPreparation: anchor and every attempted revision, outside pair wall time
timing.outputs: required output manifest SHA-256 and file count
timing.configurationCache: frozen workflow decides; runner does not add or remove it
